# Table → retention map (BE-057; 02 §24.2, KVKK md. 7 and İmha Yönetmeliği). TestEveryPersonalTableHasRetention
# reads it together with personal_tables.txt and the retention_policies seed of db/migrations:
#
#   <table>  <retention>
#
# retention  policy:<code>[,<code>…]  the retention policies whose target names the table
#            account:<reason>         kept while the account lives; the module's KVKK provider erases it
#                                     (02 §24.2: "hesap yaşadıkça saklanan kayıtlar için satır yoktur")
#            parent:<table>           the rows go with their parent row (FK cascade or the parent's purge)
#            todo:BE-NNN              no policy yet; the ticket decides it (P3 code)
#
# Every personal (or special category) table of personal_tables.txt has a line, and every table a seeded
# policy names has a line listing that policy. A policy code that is not seeded, a policy whose target does
# not name the table, an account line for a table without a provider, or a parent without retention fails.

# platform
outbox                      policy:outbox_published
webhook_inbox               policy:webhook_payload,webhook_row
idempotency_keys            policy:idempotency
# audit
audit_events                policy:audit_events
audit_daily_roots           policy:audit_roots
# files: unattached uploads, documents and generated files by purpose; avatars and CVs live with the account
files                       policy:files_orphan,edu_document,event_export_file,dsr_export_file,financial_records
# files: delivery_evidence uploads (BE-093) go with their order line: financial_records (files:financial; their destruction is T-280)
# consent
consents                    policy:consent_proof
iys_submissions             policy:consent_proof
terms_acceptances           policy:terms_acceptance
iys_netgsm_events           policy:iys_netgsm_event
unsubscribe_links           policy:unsubscribe_link
# identity
users                       policy:dsr_erasure,dormant_account
sessions                    policy:session_expired
email_tokens                policy:email_token
platform_role_assignments   policy:role_history
privileged_account_actions  policy:privileged_action_history
edu_verifications           policy:edu_verification_history
mfa_totp                    account:the second factor of the account; identity's provider deletes it on erasure
mfa_recovery_codes          account:the recovery codes of the account; identity's provider deletes them on erasure
# notify
notification_deliveries     policy:notification_delivery
email_suppressions          policy:email_suppression
push_tokens                 policy:push_token
in_app_notifications        policy:in_app_notification
notification_preferences    account:the user's notification settings; notify's provider deletes them on erasure
# orgs
org_members                 policy:membership_ended,membership_ended_sensitive
org_invitations             policy:org_invitation
# directory
club_claims                 policy:club_claim
# students: the profile lives with the account (students provider); access grants end with their policy
student_profiles            account:the student profile; students' provider deletes it on erasure
student_privacy_settings    account:the profile's privacy settings; students' provider deletes them on erasure
student_skills              account:the profile's skills; students' provider deletes them on erasure
student_experiences         account:the profile's experiences; students' provider deletes them on erasure
student_languages           account:the profile's languages; students' provider deletes them on erasure
student_cvs                 account:the student's CVs (and files); students' provider deletes them on erasure
profile_access_grants       policy:access_grant_revoked
# entitlements
entitlements                policy:entitlement_other
entitlement_usages          parent:entitlements
# events: the registration core lives with the account (02 §24.2 registration_core); answers end earlier
event_staff                 policy:event_staff
event_registrations         policy:event_form_answers,event_form_answers_sensitive
registration_tickets        parent:event_registrations
event_checkins              parent:event_registrations
event_data_exports          policy:event_export_log
# feed
posts                       policy:post_removed
post_dropped_media          policy:post_media_dropped
post_reactions              account:the user's likes; feed's provider deletes them on erasure
post_saves                  account:the user's saved posts; feed's provider deletes them on erasure
post_hides                  account:the user's hidden posts; feed's provider deletes them on erasure
org_follows                 account:the user's follows; feed's provider deletes them on erasure
org_mutes                   account:the user's mutes; feed's provider deletes them on erasure
content_reports             policy:content_report
moderation_actions          policy:moderation_action
# outreach
outreach_dispatches         policy:outreach_dispatch
# messaging (P3)
contact_requests            policy:contact_request_closed
contact_blocks              account:the user's blocks of companies; the messaging provider deletes them (BE-056)
# talent (P3, profiling data)
talent.point_events         policy:talent_ledger
talent.daily_counters       policy:talent_counters
talent.score_runs           policy:talent_runs
talent.neutralizations      policy:talent_neutralization
# cohorts and scores: overwritten nightly while collection is on (02 §15.5, §15.6; talent.recompute deletes a user's rows
# once the user has no ledger row in lookback_days), all deleted nightly while it is off (BE-087, T-324), and erased
# with the account by talent's provider; the run's deletions with collection on are recorded under talent_score_dropped
# (BE-101, T-342)
talent.cohorts              policy:talent_collection_off,talent_score_dropped
talent.scores               policy:talent_collection_off,talent_score_dropped
# kvkk
data_subject_requests       policy:dsr_record
destruction_logs            policy:destruction_log
breach_incidents            policy:breach_record
# financial records (10 years from the end of the calendar year; 06 H-57)
legal_parties               policy:financial_records
legal_party_documents       policy:financial_records
payees                      policy:financial_records
payee_bank_accounts         policy:financial_records
orders                      policy:financial_records
order_lines                 policy:financial_records
# order_lines.fulfillment_evidence_file_id (BE-093): the seller's delivery evidence stays with the line (financial_records)
incoming_bank_transfers     policy:financial_records
payments                    policy:financial_records
payment_splits              policy:financial_records
refunds                     policy:financial_records
ledger_transactions         policy:financial_records
ledger_entries              policy:financial_records
payouts                     policy:financial_records
payout_items                policy:financial_records
invoices                    policy:financial_records
invoice_lines               policy:financial_records

receivable_collections     policy:financial_records
# BE-132: a refund request goes with its order (FK ON DELETE CASCADE in the financial_records purge); its evidence file stays (T-280)
refund_requests             parent:orders
